description: Applies multiple user-visible plan item updates atomically in the listed order. Use this for a necessary multi-row reconciliation. First-build handoffs use sequential update_plan_item calls: complete the current item, wait for success, then start the next. Preserve completed attempts; use unresolved rows or new linked follow-up work instead of reopening them. Each update target is required and must be `{type:"id", itemId}` or `{type:"position", position}`; each update has a `patch` object. Do not update the same target item twice in one update_plan_items call. If a validation attempt is unsuccessful, one update may mark that current item completed with outcome.status="unsuccessful" or "partial" and evidence; follow-up work references the attempt. This tool cannot create a new plan item or future position; use add_plan_item with a nested item object, or replace_plan_items when you need to resolve existing rows and add a new row in one visible plan mutation. Do not use this tool to target a future validation position before or after a domain tool returns an external id. After that tool returns, either update only the existing item here and then call add_plan_item, or use replace_plan_items for the whole visible list. When working in the current conversation, omit planId unless you already have the actual plan UUID; never pass a plan item id as planId. The final visible plan must still be ordered and must have at most one in_progress item. This is a normal model-owned plan mutation tool, not hidden backend reconciliation. It does not perform domain work, hide tools, or change backtests, deployments, trades, files, or strategy state.

conversationId.description: Optional conversation UUID. Omit this field to use the current MCP conversation context; never pass placeholders such as `current`.

planId.description: Optional plan UUID. In the current conversation, omit planId unless you already have the actual plan id from get_active_plan or a wake message. Never pass a plan item id here; target plan items through target.itemId or target.position.

updates.description: Ordered item patches to apply atomically. Use this instead of multiple parallel update_plan_item calls.

dependsOnItemIds.description: Optional explicit item UUID dependencies. Do not use this to skip unresolved earlier work.

evidence.description: Domain-tool evidence for this item. Put returned externalKind and externalId inside this object; they are not top-level item fields. Keep externalWaitId on the item itself when returned.

status.description: Plan-item outcome relative to this item's completionCriteria, not an external resource status. For external tool work, read the real external status/evidence first, store that evidence, then choose whether this plan item was satisfied, unsuccessful, partial, or not_applicable.

outcome.description: Optional plan-item outcome evidence. This is not backtest.status, deployment.status, or trade status; store external statuses in evidence and use outcome.status only to say whether this plan item satisfied its completionCriteria.

parentItemId.description: Optional parent item UUID when this item is an explicit follow-up attempt or child of another visible item.

name: update_plan_items
title: Update plan items
